rules.title: 五个内置角色、可扩展性、one-line duties、dual-sign、video sole entry、共享区绝对路径
卡片是唯一持久载体；schema 归 provider，团队不复述

英文/结论先行/证据/不编造；模板 A1–A8 + L/J/T；operator 中文例外
权限/历史自证需 sessions_history 验证

registry 唯一（claude-sessions.json；turing-runs.json 仅 legacy log）/caps/单一 spawn/poll/NDJSON/resume
破坏性 git 禁令/正向修复/禁 force push
引用规范 R-* / guide §N / 裸 §N
默认 deepseek-flash/升级 v4-pro/effort/不盲目最高最低/scope
并行优先；四类 serialize；same-file 仅 warn
dev 集成/卡分支/worktree/主 checkout 持 dev/merge before done/closeout 顺序
blocked 退回/不猜/只有 Elon 退回/回归路径
四步注册/元数据/kind/identity code/后端可换
产品/UX 验收触发/时序/closure/review_of/分工
任务类型路由/角色边界
动态评审参与者；chain 不削减 nature-required participants
epic/child/all batches 一次注册/depends_on/review_of 豁免/rollup/archive/no extra depth
建卡权/粒度/48h soft guard/env var/warn-not-hard/__team__ target hard gate
一卡一 Acceptance/四种 seg 理由/split 触发/anti-patterns
A/B/C/hard boundary/质量脊/报告集/gate 不缩/20% sample
Jobs 前置任务：触发/形式/depends_on/deps_unmet/多轮/重入/reuse
不执行/blocked 退回/Elon 改派/不得自行改派
建卡 doc criterion/验收检查/反向回填/归属
最小启动自检（读本 AGENTS）
确认门触发/责任/动作/证据/双签/[confirm-request]/fallback/不得下游使用/超时
新分层：AGENTS 规则层 / guides 方法层 / 无中心协议
禁逐字复制；deliberate carriage 含生成副本
guides 不得引用退役两册
结论先行/先读 AGENTS+卡/状态纪律/最小权限/不猜
机器门注册/落点/两模式/调度裁决/fail-closed
不可机器门清单 + 四个 merge 缺口
发布审批/operator 升级/confirm trail
三类对象/不可替代/gap/三问
LLM 语义去重（creator）+ idem key（ACL/patrol）+ 原子锁/豁免
素材范围/README+_templates 权威/fact note/snapshot/归档

contradictions.issue: P:34/42 and redlines.core.md:12 disagree on backlog, canceled entry, failed alias and blocked scope.
contradictions.resolution: One canonical diagram; rewrite redline item 5.

contradictions.issue: P:392/redline call in_review/blocked terminal; only done/canceled are terminal.
contradictions.resolution: Use “closing state” for the three-item closeout.

contradictions.issue: “information does not enter the task card” contradicts the next bullet (Progress is on the card).
contradictions.resolution: Decisions/conventions do not enter the card; milestones do.

contradictions.issue: P:490 defaults writes to ~/.openclaw/team/**; P:79–82 confines project cards to the project root.
contradictions.resolution: State that the default applies to __team__/internal chores only.

contradictions.issue: P:65 destructive migration and P:76 deprecation window require approval, but §14 triggers list only plan.md/product docs.
contradictions.resolution: Add destructive migration and deprecation to R-CONFIRM-1 triggers.

contradictions.issue: release-versioning-sop §4.1 says 80% is “to be decided”; engineering-standards clause 2 says ≥80% hard.
contradictions.resolution: One authoritative threshold in R-ENG-1 clause 2.

contradictions.resolution: Define Terry = operator alias or normalize; state the operator-facing Chinese exception.

contradictions.resolution: Unify to hourly + 30min, or label 15min as a patrol heuristic.
